system.description:
A creature suffering Stupor has been injected with a synthetic hallucinogenic that assaults their brains ability to process information.

A creature with Stupor suffers a -2 penalty to all Strength and Dexterity based rolls.

A creature with Stupor has all ranks of Mastery suppressed.

A creature immune to the Envenomed condition is immune to this condition.

A creature with Stupor can spend an Action, to make a DC 20 Constitution or Intelligence ability check to end this affliction.
system.summary: −2 to all Strength and Dexterity rolls; all Mastery suppressed; DC 20 Constitution or Intelligence to end.

rules.text: −2 also applies to its Strength and Dexterity skill checks and attacks. All its ranks of Mastery are suppressed (at the table).
